KIN=np.load(OUT/'kin.npz') if (OUT/'kin.npz').exists() else None
CAMREL=np.array([[2**-.5,2**-.5,0],[2**-.5,-2**-.5,0],[0,0,-1]])
def worldfk(q):
 t=fk(q);R=KIN['R']@t[:3,:3];p=KIN['R']@t[:3,3]+KIN['b']+R@KIN['tip'];return p,R

def ik(p,q,camR=None):
 Rtarget=None if camR is None else np.array(camR)@CAMREL.T
 def fun(x):
  pos,R=worldfk(x);err=list((pos-p)*5)
  if Rtarget is not None:err+=list(Rotation.from_matrix(Rtarget@R.T).as_rotvec())
  err+=list((x-q)*.015)
  return err
 sol=least_squares(fun,q,bounds=([-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-.0175,-2.8973],[2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973]),max_nfev=300)
 print('ik error',worldfk(sol.x)[0]-p,'target',sol.x,flush=True)
 return sol.x

def move(r,o,p,seconds=3,grip=None,name='move',yaw=None):
 # default camera x -world x, y -world y, looking straight down
 if yaw is None:camR=np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.])
 else:camR=Rotation.from_euler('z',yaw).as_matrix()
 return joint(r,o,ik(np.array(p),qnow(o),camR),seconds,grip,name)

def pixel(name,cam,u,v):
 meta=json.loads((OUT/name/'meta.json').read_text());cal=meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl']);d=np.load(OUT/name/f'depth_{cam}.npy');d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
 z=float(d[int(v),int(u)]);p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1])*z;p[1:]*=-1
 return T[:3,:3]@p+T[:3,3]

def cartmove(r,o,p,seconds=4,grip=None,name='cartmove',yaw=np.pi):
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 p=np.array(p);p0,R0=worldfk(qnow(o));C0=R0@CAMREL;C1=Rotation.from_euler('z',yaw).as_matrix();slerp=Slerp([0,1],Rotation.from_matrix(np.stack([C0,C1])))
 q=qnow(o);N=int(seconds/.05);A=np.zeros((N,13));A[:,7]=state(o)['cmd_grip'] if grip is None else grip;A[:,12]=-1
 for i,t in enumerate(np.linspace(0,1,N)):
  pt=p0+(p-p0)*t;Rt=slerp(t).as_matrix()@CAMREL.T
  def fun(x):
   pp,RR=worldfk(x);return np.r_[(pp-pt)*5,Rotation.from_matrix(Rt@RR.T).as_rotvec(),(x-q)*.03]
  sol=least_squares(fun,q,bounds=([-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-.0175,-2.8973],[2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973]),max_nfev=100)
  q=sol.x;A[i,:7]=q
 print('cart final error',worldfk(q)[0]-p,'q',q,flush=True)
 out=r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=CAMS,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name);save(out,name);return out
